Nekomimi means an otherwise human adult with a small pair of living feline ears organically rooted in the hairline; keep the human face, arms, hands, nails, and body proportions ordinary.

Use an asymmetric ear-first reflex as character-response evidence: name the visible trigger, turn only the nearer or trigger-side ear toward it, and keep the other ear in its baseline angle so direction survives a still frame. Keep fur limited to a millimeter-scale transition around the ear roots; do not add furry forearms, paw hands, long claws, a muzzle, or a tail unless explicitly requested.
The requested role outfit and action remain primary. Nekomimi is a sensory-response layer, not a full beastkin body transformation or an animal-ear costume accessory.
compact feline nekomimi ears with organic hairline roots; otherwise fully human adult arms, hands, nails, face, and body proportions

principles: Bind the subject and setting with shared light, reflected color, contact shadow, moisture, haze, or material behavior.
Use a photographic point of view with foreground depth, asymmetry, focus falloff, grain, or lens artifacts instead of a clean pasted-on portrait.
Keep one small human, animal, object, or material imperfection so the image reads as a captured moment rather than a beauty composite.
Let one small bodily or behavioral trace interrupt pure polish: loose hair, breath, fabric creasing, sweat, handling, or an unguarded expression.
Use window light, practical lamps, room color bounce, dust, and foreground domestic objects to make the subject belong to the room.
Close camera positions need visible focus falloff, foreground occlusion, lens perspective, or grain so the image does not flatten into a composite.
Colored or mixed light should spill consistently across subject, wardrobe, props, and nearby surfaces instead of sitting only in the background.

environment_binding: ambient light spills across the subject, nearby surfaces, and props
reflected color catches on the main subject and the surrounding materials
room light and color bounce touch the subject, nearby surfaces, and small foreground objects
optical_depth: off-axis composition with foreground occlusion and gentle focus falloff
subtle lens grain and imperfect depth cues from a real camera position
foreground occlusion, focus falloff, lens perspective, or grain reveals a real camera position
human_trace: a small unguarded expression, loose hair, creased fabric, handling mark, or material imperfection breaks the polished pose
loose hair, creased fabric, breath, or an unguarded expression keeps the subject photographic
material_trace: moisture darkens fabric, gathers on hair or surfaces, and catches the same light as the environment

anti_patterns: centered beauty headshot pasted over a scenic background
separate studio face light that ignores the location's light direction
props listed as labels without contact shadow, reflection, weight, or physical interaction

moe_response.relationship_register_instruction: Use mature, benevolent protective warmth: relaxed brow, patient soft eyes, reassuring mouth, and calm attention toward the cared-for person or object. Do not force tsundere denial or romantic gaze leakage.
moe_response.aesthetic_instruction: Use the uploaded portrait as the sole identity reference for the same unmistakably adult woman. Preserve her facial geometry, eye shape and spacing, brows, nose, lips, jawline, cheekbones, skin tone, natural asymmetry, hairline, and adult age. Do not substitute, average, beautify by reshaping, or de-age her face. Make the preserved identity read as both pretty and cute through adult micro-expression, grooming, cohesive styling, pose, and light; any adult sexual appeal must remain subordinate to her face, agency, and character-specific response.
moe_response.sexual_tone_instruction: Subtle adult sensual appeal may support gaze, pose, silhouette, styling, or light at low intensity, but it must not replace the pretty-and-cute first read, visible agency, or character-specific event.
moe_response.mechanism_instruction: Show a specific caring action directed at a visible recipient or used object, with a small state change that proves the care rather than a generic kind expression. For a mamang or maternal request, make mature benevolence visible through a relaxed brow, patient soft eyes, a reassuring mouth, and protective attention; do not add active denial or a romantic eye-line contradiction.

prompt_budget.rule: Keep prompt_en between 50 and 120 English words. Reuse short literal phrases across moe, viewer, identity, and augmentation evidence instead of stacking explanations.

aesthetic_entry_condition.rule: The character must first read as an attractive adult bishoujo, bishonen, or explicitly requested androgynous equivalent. Pretty and cute are both required; this entry condition cannot replace the causal character event.

affective_balance.rule: The face must show one specific warm, pleased, relieved, fond, or playfully embarrassed micro-response in addition to any guarded, annoyed, or flustered cue. Negative affect may frame the contradiction but must not dominate the first facial read.

denial_care_leak.rule: Bind a separate visible mouth, chin, shoulder, or helping-hand protest; guardedness, the tsundere label, or averted gaze alone is not active denial. Place the care target—hand, wound, or carried object—in-frame at an explicit lower screen position. Separately establish the same adult recipient's face, profile, eyes, or face-level near-lens eye line above that task anchor. Keep the character's head angled away while the irises return toward the face-level relationship anchor, paired with a barely visible and suppressed flash of private personal liking. Looking only at the hand, wound, object, or task reads as nurturance or mamang rather than peer liking under denial.

nurturant_benevolence.rule: For an explicit mamang, maternal, or motherly request, bind one literal benevolent-affect phrase that combines a relaxed brow, patient soft eyes, a reassuring mouth, and calm protective attention. Do not substitute tsundere denial, romantic gaze leakage, or generic kindness.

render_legibility.unfinished_state: Name one physical separation that cannot be mistaken for the settled endpoint, such as an open gap, a partway contact boundary, an object outside its destination, or an off-center trace.
render_legibility.directional_reflex: For a nonhuman reflex, keep the visible trigger and responding body part in-frame; an ear response must be asymmetric and aimed toward that trigger. For nekomimi, each ear must remain compact—no taller than the visible human ear from base to tip—and the two ear tips must occupy clearly different angles.
render_legibility.split_care_and_relationship_vectors: For denial_care_leak, keep the visible care-action target low in-frame, but direct the concealed affection toward the same adult recipient's separate face-level eye line. Keep the head angled away, return only the irises toward that relationship anchor, and suppress one private-liking cue.
render_legibility.intermediate_prop_scale: Keep an intermediate sleeve, tool, vessel, or other prop at ordinary real-world scale so it does not hide the hands or contact state that carry the event.
render_legibility.text_free_background: Use a plain material background or unlettered decor: no menu board, chalkboard writing, signage, captions, pseudo-writing, or decorative heart/sparkle symbols.
